title: fix(workflows): let the email preview fill the step panel

session.source: t3code (claudeAgent provider; transcript is the Claude Code JSONL)
session.title: Expand Workflow Email Preview

taskStatement:
There seems to be a bug where the email preview in workflows does not expand to fill the available space: ![image.png](t3-context://v1/image/image_057e3901-b33a-4afa-885b-f346966b814f) 
- Fix it and prove the fix with a screenshot.
- Make sure that you also attach screenshots for a mobile view so it doesn't break there for various screen sizes.
whyChosen: A layout bug whose fix spans a shared component (frontend/src/lib CyclotronJobInputs), the hog-functions email templater and the workflows product panel, so it tests whether the fix lands in the shared seam or leaks product-specific patches.
